subtasks: Cover the blocks from left to right, remember their colors, then uncover them in the order: red, green, and blue.
Uncover the red block under the center cup. Lift the center cup and set it inverted in front of the red block, leaving both outer blocks covered.
Uncover the green block under the right cup. Lift only the right cup and set it inverted in front of the green block. Leave the left cup and the exposed red block undisturbed.
Uncover the blue block under the left cup. Lift the left cup vertically and set it inverted in front of the blue block. Then fully open both grippers and return both arms to their initial poses.
